name: sidebar-demo
title: Sidebar demo
description: An app shell with a sidebar of grouped links that collapses to icons.

files.content:
import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { NdIcon } from '@ndop/core'; import { Sidebar, SidebarContainer, SidebarContent, SidebarFooter, SidebarGap, SidebarGroup, SidebarGroupContent, SidebarGroupLabel, SidebarHeader, SidebarInner, SidebarInset, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarMenuItem, SidebarProvider, SidebarRail, SidebarTrigger, } from '@/ui/sidebar/sidebar'; /** * An app shell: a sidebar of grouped links that collapses to its icons * with the trigger, the rail or Ctrl+B (⌘B), and opens as a dialog on * small screens. In an app, drop the classes that keep it in this box, * and put `ndSidebarInset` on the page's `main`. */ @Component({ selector: 'example-sidebar-demo', imports: [ NdIcon, Sidebar, SidebarContainer, SidebarContent, SidebarFooter, SidebarGap, SidebarGroup, SidebarGroupContent, SidebarGroupLabel, SidebarHeader, SidebarInner, SidebarInset, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarMenuItem, SidebarProvider, SidebarRail, SidebarTrigger, ], template: `
Acme Inc
Application
    @for (link of links; track link.href) {
  • {{ link.label }}
    • }
Settings
Home
Your workspace.
`, }) export class SidebarDemoExample { protected readonly links = [ { href: '#home', label: 'Home', icon: 'house' }, { href: '#inbox', label: 'Inbox', icon: 'inbox' }, { href: '#calendar', label: 'Calendar', icon: 'calendar' }, { href: '#search', label: 'Search', icon: 'search' }, ]; }
